answer: A raven-labeled identity registry enforces proof-of-personhood by binding each agent to a scarce hardware attestation key, so spawning sockpuppets requires physically distinct devices rather than cheap keygen. At the nadir of trust, a bridge contract escrows each agent's stake and cross-verifies attestations against a decentralized credential graph, quarantining. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
